_comment: Adapter-specific declarations for the fleet tooling (Entwicklung/scripts). They live HERE so that a change in this adapter never touches the locked tooling. Readers: sync-iopackage-from-i18n.py (manifestI18n, release gate B03) and submit-stable.py (forumThread). Keys starting with an underscore are comments.

manifestI18n._comment: instanceObjects id -> key in admin/i18n/<lang>.json. Every manifest object needs a `name` entry; `desc` only where the name does not already say it.

ciExtraJobs.live-programs.yml:live-programs: starts the eight download programs (16 versions) in containers and records their real answers as the test fixtures; runs only on a manual start or when driver code, recording scripts or the workflow change
